description: AICTIONBOT™ invoice against contract by KULIC Advisory (tool 63). Takes the agreed prices from a contract or price list and the items of an invoice and matches them by description, otherwise by item number. Returns every item billed above the agreed price with the overbilled amount (red), items that are not in the contract (yellow), items billed below the agreed price, the invoice total at contract prices, a ready message asking the supplier for a credit note and the next step. Pass two arrays (contract_rows and invoice_rows) or one array rows with a source column (Contract or Invoice; German: Vertrag or Rechnung). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Not legal advice. To compare an invoice with the previous invoice use compare_invoices, to match it with order and goods receipt use match_documents. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

contract_rows.description: Agreed prices: position (item number), description, unit_price. German column names work too.

invoice_rows.description: Invoice items: position, description, quantity, unit_price, optionally total.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Alternative to contract_rows and invoice_rows: one list with a source column (Contract or Invoice) plus the columns above.

supplier.description: Optional: supplier name for the message.

name: compare_invoice_to_contract
title: Invoice against contract: is every invoiced price the agreed price? Overbilling per item, items outside the contract, ready credit note request
